from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, sys, time
lines = Path('.github/dcoir_review/openrouter-pr-review-pareto.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
commands=[]
in_section=False
for line in lines:
    if line == 'validation_commands:':
        in_section=True
        continue
    if not in_section:
        continue
    if line.startswith('  - '):
        commands.append(line[4:])
        continue
    if line and not line.startswith('  '):
        break
if len(commands) != 55:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected 55 governed commands, found {len(commands)}')
env=os.environ.copy()
for name in ('OPENROUTER_API_KEY','OPENAI_API_KEY','DCOIR_OPENAI_API_KEY','DCOIR_OPENAI_PROJECT_ID','GEMINI_API_KEY','GOOGLE_API_KEY','DCOIR_GEMINI_API'):
    env.pop(name, None)
start=time.time()
for index, command in enumerate(commands,1):
    print(f'[{index:02d}/55] {command}', flush=True)
    result=subprocess.run(command, shell=True, env=env)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(f'governed command {index} failed rc={result.returncode}: {command}')
print(f'GOVERNED_VALIDATION_PASS total=55 elapsed={time.time()-start:.1f}s')
'@
